description: Long-press x, y in physical pixels, or the center of the node whose text or contentDesc (iOS: label or value) equals text, or whose resource id (iOS: identifier) matches id. An iPhone needs install_runner once.

id.description: Resource id, full or the part after :id/ (iOS: identifier).

text.description: Exact text or contentDesc (iOS: label or value), case-sensitive.

timeout.description: With text or id: ms to keep reading the tree until the node appears; the call can run up to 6 s longer.

name: long_press
title: Long-press
